captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic tower crane standing on a solid grey rectangular concrete-style base. The main vertical mast is a yellow open-lattice structure made of interlocking diagonal and vertical steel members. Atop the mast sits a dark grey slewing unit and operator's cabin, from which a horizontal jib extends forward and a shorter counter-jib with a grey counterweight ballast block extends backward. A thin yellow hook block is suspended by vertical black cables, and thin black tie lines connect the top tower apex to the ends of both the jib and counter-jib.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a realistic tower crane. The model should include a thick, rectangular grey concrete base, a tall yellow lattice mast, a dark grey cabin and rotating slewing unit, a long forward-pointing yellow lattice jib, a shorter counter-jib with a heavy grey ballast block, and a suspended hook block hanging from black cables.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject containing multiple parts. It starts by creating a solid rectangular base using box primitives. The vertical mast is constructed by replicating diagonal and vertical beam primitives to form a detailed lattice truss structure. A dark grey slewing platform and cabin are modeled with boxes and cylinders, and placed on top of the mast. The horizontal jib and counter-jib are constructed as smaller triangular lattice structures using patterned beams, with a solid ballast block attached to the counter-jib. Finally, the hook block is modeled as a small cylinder with thin cables represented by long, thin cylinders, all assembled using relative coordinate transformations.
